in_sanskrit.name: Mahesh
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahish meaning great lord or bull. In Hindu mythology, Mahesh is one of the primary forms of the Hindu god Shiva, who is often depicted as a bull.

in_hindi.name: माहेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: Maharaj meaning great king or ruler, derived from Mahesh.

in_tamil.name: மாஹேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: Makkal Thiruvijayam meaning great victory for people, derived from Mahesh.

in_telugu.name: మాహేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mrudhesh meaning lord of the universe, derived from Mahesh.

in_marathi.name: Mahes
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Great Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahes हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahes is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Mahesh, also known as Shiva. The name Mahes signifies 'Lord of Great Power'. Shiva is the god of destruction and transformation, and is one of the primary deities in Hinduism.
